 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 25.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 9103/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions. CRL.M.C. 2220/2026 & CRL.M.A. 9104/2026 (stay)
2.
Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 510/2019 of Police Station Nand Nagri, Delhi for offence under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on merits.

3. It is contended by counsel for petitioners that at the time of the alleged offence, the petitioners were minor in age, so in accordance with Rule 8(1) of the Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection) Model Rules no FIR could be registered against them.
4.

Learned APP accepts notice and submits that the allegation against the present petitioners are serious and even otherwise, Rule 8(1) would not come into play because other members of the family, who are adults also are party in the offence.
